extraction_notes: The supplied five-page PDF identifies SK2301AAT as a P-channel enhancement-mode field-effect transistor; manufacturer branding is Shikues; datasheet revision is REV.08.

Transfer, output, and capacitance-versus-VDS figures are present on p. 3. Points were manually digitized from the usable plotted traces without interpolation; the 25 degC transfer trace and five representative output traces are included.
The plotted p-channel curves use positive magnitudes on their axes, while tabulated p-channel electrical quantities retain the signs printed in the datasheet.

The 125 degC transfer trace, output traces for VGS values other than -2.5 V through -5 V, and RDS(on)-versus-temperature traces were not included because the strict curve schema does not carry curve labels beyond the selected trace and the extraction targets prioritize 25 degC transfer, representative output, and capacitance curves.
The electrical-characteristics table provides Ciss = 290 pF, Coss = 47 pF, and Crss = 29 pF at VDS = -10 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz; values are converted to farads in specs.
The body-diode table also lists a minimum VSD of -0.8 V; the required single body_diode field records the published maximum magnitude value as the signed maximum value -1.2 V.
Qg, Qgs, and Qgd are present in the datasheet but have no corresponding fields in the strict MOSFET extraction schema.
